name: Gary Peters
committees: Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs
stance: Long-running focus on federal government use of AI — transparency, accountability and oversight of automated and augmented systems that interact with the public or make critical decisions.

statements.text: Our adversaries often do not consider the same moral and ethical issues that we consider each and every day

While many government organizations and businesses are working to build AI systems that enhance our daily lives, we must be open-eyed about the risks presented by bad actors and adversaries who may use AI to intentionally cause harm, or undermine our national interests.
statements.outlet: Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee hearing record (GovInfo)

statements.text: Sponsored S.5648, directing federal agencies to be transparent when using automated and augmented systems to interact with the public or make critical decisions.

Artificial intelligence is advancing at an extraordinary pace, and we must slow down its development until we establish commonsense guardrails that ensure this transformational technology is developed safely and responsibly.

review.note: added October 2026 from peters.senate.gov legislation listing (S.5648)
